rca_of_the_issue: The Playwright-simulated drag on a @dnd-kit DraggableShift did not invoke the PUT /api/staff/roster/{id} handler. Backend endpoint works perfectly (verified by pytest). Most likely root cause: @dnd-kit PointerSensor's default activationConstraint and the way Playwright's mouse.down/move/up dispatches events may not cross the sensor activation threshold in the emulated environment. The bug (if any) is on the DnD sensor activation side, not on the API. Main agent should: (a) manually drag a card in browser to confirm it works, (b) if not, add useSensors with PointerSensor + activationConstraint: { distance: 5 } and ensure DndContext's handleDragEnd invokes staffMgmtAPI.updateRosterShift(id, { date: newDate }) followed by a re-fetch of roster.
